| [ADR-054](../../../record/decisions.d/ADR-054.md) v2 | Work is pushed to its pull request as it is made, and the pull request's CI repairs and lints it; contributors do not gate a push on running the record's checks locally | CLAUDE.md told contributors to run `luria repair`, `luria link --fix`, `luria index` and `luria lint` before every push. On a pull request the docs-check job already runs the repair, pushes it onto the branch, and lints the repaired tree, so the local run did the same work twice. At the record's present size it was also slow: on 2026-10-26 one local repair–link–lint pass ran past ten minutes, and work sat unpushed while it ran. At the owner's direction (2026-10-26), work is committed and pushed to its pull request as it is made. CI is the check, and a red check is read and fixed on the branch. `luria new` stays local, and a narrow local run is still allowed for diagnosing a red check. Rejected: keeping the local gate, a local lint only, and pushing straight to the default branch. | Active |
